title: Schedule of Filing Charges: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44)
content:
## 1. Filing fee per request

Under Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44), one filing request is charged the filing fee of its certificate:

| Certificate | Filing fee (USD) |
|---|---|
| SR-22 Owner Certificate | 25.00 |
| SR-22 Operator Certificate | 25.00 |
| SR-22 Owner-Operator Certificate | 25.00 |
| FR-44 Owner Certificate | 35.00 |
| FR-44 Operator Certificate | 35.00 |
| FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate | 35.00 |

The scope of this figure is limited in three cases:

- **Reinstatement refiling.** A reinstatement refiling that replaces a certificate whose SR-26 was transmitted for a cancellation of its since-reinstated backing term is charged the refiling fee the company works out for such a refiling, and only such a refiling is. That fee is charged once when the refiling is requested and billed on the backing term's billing plan.
- **State-change refiling after a move.** A state-change refiling after a move is charged the moved certificate fee, and only such a refiling is. That fee is charged once when the refiling is requested and billed on the new term's billing plan.
- **Fee charged again.** A filing requested for a charged reason whose fee charges were all reversed in full as charged in error is charged again at the fee the company works out for a fee charged again, and only such a filing is. That fee is billed on the backing term's billing plan.

Every other filing requested for a reason on the charged list below is charged the certificate's filing fee from the table above, once, when it is requested, billed on the backing term's billing plan.

## 2. Reasons charged and reasons free (all six certificates)

| Filing reason | Filing fee |
|---|---|
| new requirement | charged |
| reinstatement refiling | charged |
| state change | charged |
| carrier transfer | charged |
| corrected refiling | no fee |

## 3. Reasons a charged fee is reversed (all six certificates)

- the request was withdrawn before transmission
- company error
- duplicate request

## 4. Other terms of the charge (all six certificates)

- **Cancellation of the backing term.** A filing fee is not returned when the backing term cancels after the certificate was transmitted.
- **Renewal.** A renewal of the backing policy needs no new filing; the certificate carries forward to the renewal term.
- **Where the fee is billed.** The filing fee is billed on the backing term's billing plan, with the down payment or with the next invoice.

## 5. Hypothetical readings of the schedule

- A new-requirement request for an FR-44 Owner-Operator Certificate falls under section 1's closing sentence and is charged 35.00.
- A corrected refiling of an SR-22 Owner Certificate carries no filing fee under section 2.
- A carrier-transfer request for an SR-22 Operator Certificate is a charged reason and is charged 25.00 under section 1's closing sentence.
